# curl

Transfer HTTP and HTTPS data through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/curl https://example.com/

moonx cli/curl -L -o page.html https://example.com/

moonx cli/curl -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary '{"ok":true}' https://example.com/
```

Write response bodies to stdout by default. Supports configured headers, Basic authentication, cookies, redirects, retries, uploads and resume in the documented HTTP profile.

| `-u VALUE`, `--user VALUE` | HTTP Basic authentication |
| `-c VALUE`, `--cookie-jar VALUE` | write a Netscape cookie jar |
| `-X VALUE`, `--request VALUE` | specify a supported HTTP method |
| `-d VALUE`, `--data VALUE` | HTTP POST data |

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Protocols other than HTTP(S), non-Basic authentication and password prompts are unsupported. Redirect/replay rules depend on the request body and credential scope.
- TLS, proxy and network access depend on the launcher and runtime. Full upstream URL/IRI, config and Cookie grammar is not claimed.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
